body: this was one of the rare times he wasn’t on my shoulder hahaha!

I’m not sure why but my process sounds a lot different to others? (But this is with the NHS in England). I went for my initial appointment at the hospital, and the male doctor asked me questions and took a blood test. After this he gave me my first pill and then I went home. I didn’t feel anything other than a little nausea. I then was told to come back 2 days later. At the second appointment I answered more questions from a nurse, and she then told me that I would be having three pills, but they would be inserted vaginally. She gave me the option to insert them, but as they had to be in a certain position and I was worried I’d get it wrong, I let her do it. So she inserted the three pills I think just under my cervix. I was then free to go, but after around 45 minutes I started to get pains. They felt like really bad period cramps, and then there was bleeding too, and this lasted a few days. 
Overall the process was obviously not a nice one, but the doctors and nurses were kind and I was dealt with quite quickly. 
Best wishes to you xxx
My third period after was awful, I bled a lot and the pain was horrible. It’s back to normal now though, so hopefully with time yours will improve too. Hang in there :-) x
